title: Mathematical exploration and discovery at scale

mechanism.domainTask: Mathematical construction search, optimization heuristics, and generalizing formula discovery
mechanism.populationDetail: The paper describes a population and semi-independent parallel threads that communicate and share best constructions, but does not expose whether the maintained population is flat, island-partitioned, or database-organized.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Best constructions and prior best solutions are shared/reused, but this paper does not specify a separate elite archive or its retention rule.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The overview says higher-scoring offspring form the basis of future programs, but does not state whether parent survivors are fully replaced, mixed into the next set, or admitted to a separate archive.
mechanism.generationDetail: The LLM mutates selected parent programs, and AlphaEvolve is described as evolving entire code files up to hundreds of lines rather than applying a narrowly localized patch.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Problem-specific numerical fitness results and previous strong solutions can be shown in prompts, but the paper does not define a general structured side-metadata channel beyond the objective score.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The paper establishes quality-biased parent choice at a high level but not exact parent cardinality or sampling probability.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: In its main search mode, the evolved program is itself a heuristic that launches an inner search for mathematical constructions under a time budget; the LLM evolves the search procedure, not the final construction directly.

provenance.citationWarning: The survey currently cites this paper for Large-Scale Modification and Approximate Evaluation, both supported. The source describes model comparisons/mixed cheap and high-end calls and parallel evaluation, which could merit additional Chapter 5/6 placements. Population organization, archive/replacement logic, exact prompt template, model identities, and parent sampling are not specified at system level here; avoid importing under-specified details from another AlphaEvolve source without separate evidence.
